darkside: a liquid argon detector for dark matter
protodune: a liquid argon neutrino detector prototype
xenon1t: a xenon detector for dark matter
lux: a xenon detector for dark matter, earlier generation
gerda: a germanium detector array for rare decays
exo200: a xenon detector for neutrinoless double beta decay
lhcb: a forward spectrometer for flavour physics at a collider
